answer: An agent buying sable habitat reports and raven counts follows supplier referrals to find a mirror archive. Its local resolver allows at most eight outbound lookups per purchase request, counting every branch and retry against one counter. Referrals cannot create a new request or reset that counter. A chain of fake supplier identities therefore cannot make the buyer perform unbounded discovery work. This caps sybil referral amplification, not false reports; exhausting the budget may still hide a genuine supplier.
